hooks.text: 好友可接管常驻同伴，本地或Remote Play并肩作战且同伴随主角同步成长
hooks.excerpt: You won’t have to face the darkness alone. Invite a friend to take over one of your heroes and act as your companion. Your companion always follows you into battle and levels alongside your main character. Your companions will be as powerful as you have grown them to be! You can play Co-op through Steam Remote Play or locally.
